top_categories.workout_context: 7,500ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour's High-altitude Pyrenean gravel, Cerdagne plateau forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
121ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
7,500ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on high-altitude gravel loops across the Cerdagne. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
62 miles on high-altitude gravel loops across the Cerdagne burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Base fitness for Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work for 7,500ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour with 7,500ft of climbing, much of it above 8,000ft demands altitude preparation. Arrive 5–7 days early for acclimatization. Expect 5–15% power reduction at altitude. Increase iron intake 4 weeks out. Hydrate aggressively — altitude increases fluid loss by 20–40%. Fast temperature changes at mountain elevation.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Pyrénées Catalanes Gravel Tour requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on high-altitude gravel loops across the cerdagne plateau to build confidence. Expect: high-altitude pyrenean gravel, cerdagne plateau, three-loop uci qualifier.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 62 miles of high-altitude gravel loops across the cerdagne plateau in Font-Romeu, Pyrénées-Orientales, France.
